deviations.source_anchor: The 8-golem menagerie (flame golems kill, other golem types buff the squad via jewels) maps via PROXY_ASCENSION + PROXY_CONVERGENCE + two proxy skill-entries, but the SPECIFIC engine of it -- Primordial Harmony cooldown-resets as the flame-golem DPS multiplier and Primordial Eminence as a per-golem-type effectiveness aura -- is abstracted to minion-cast-speed + golem-effectiveness affixes rather than a bespoke 'jewel-driven cooldown-reset + menagerie-buff' primitive. A player keeps the 'command a diverse golem squad where support-golems empower the killers' identity; the exact Primordial-jewel scaling loop is generalized to proxy traits.

mapping.deviation_notes: The 8-golem menagerie (flame golems kill, other golem types buff the squad via jewels) maps via PROXY_ASCENSION + PROXY_CONVERGENCE + two proxy skill-entries, but the SPECIFIC engine of it -- Primordial Harmony cooldown-resets as the flame-golem DPS multiplier and Primordial Eminence as a per-golem-type effectiveness aura -- is abstracted to minion-cast-speed + golem-effectiveness affixes rather than a bespoke 'jewel-driven cooldown-reset + menagerie-buff' primitive. A player keeps the 'command a diverse golem squad where support-golems empower the killers' identity; the exact Primordial-jewel scaling loop is generalized to proxy traits.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: PROXY-MENAGERIE build -- PROXY_ASCENSION (the summoner minion archetype) + PROXY_CONVERGENCE (multiple proxy TYPES converging into one build where the menagerie's combined effect drives output; the support-golems buff the damage-golems). fire family (Flame Golems are the damage), burn as the ignite rider (probe control=burn). Geometry totem for each golem (autonomous placed proxy). THE IDENTITY = 'Primordial jewels turn a menagerie of golem types into the whole build' -- Harmony jewels reset flame-golem cooldowns (the DPS driver -> minion-cast-speed/cooldown trait) and Eminence jewels grant Golem Effectiveness across the squad (the network-buff -> golem-effectiveness affix). This is captured by the two-proxy-entry + PROXY_CONVERGENCE reading: damage-proxies (flame) + support-proxies (ice/lightning/stone) as one convergent engine. Physical rule N/A (fire-scaled). Player has no personal attack (dossier: 'player repositions while golem army kills'). Carrion Golem is a later-era evolution variant (noted).
